title: Joyful Mathematics (Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 1) — Grade 1 Mathematics (CBSE / NCERT)

source.title: Joyful Mathematics (Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 1)
source.edition: NCERT reprint 2026-27 (first edition 2023 per my knowledge; not verified)
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g01.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://ciet.ncert.gov.in/audio-book/118 https://ciet.ncert.gov.in/audio-book/119 https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/aejm1ps.pdf https://edustud.nic.in/edu/Syllabus_2026_27/1/1_math_english_2026_27.pdf. Notes: CBSE does not publish its own Classes 1-5 mathematics syllabus; CBSE schools follow the NCERT textbooks. The 2026-27 prescription was confirmed via official government split-up syllabi (Delhi Directorate of Education; KVS where available) and the NCERT reprint 2026-27 label. NCERT's 'Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage' (tilops101.pdf) could not be opened (robots-blocked); outcomes are written in my own words from the chapter content and the official DoE/KVS split-up outcomes. Outcomes are not copied from the textbook; questionTypes and difficulty are my judgement.

outcomes.text: Describe where an object is using position words such as inside/outside, above/below, near/far, in front of/behind.
